_about: Seeking Jesus of Nazareth artwork register (handoff 1.0, 2026-10-29). The sjArt(id) macro renders an item only when its status is APPROVED_DEPLOY. Every other status renders nothing. scripts/sjn-verify-artwork.js fails the build if an approved item's files are missing or the wrong size, if any file in srcDir is not claimed by an approved item, or if a pending, candidate, storyboard or reference image appears anywhere under src/assets. Status changes only on Aaron's recorded approval. decision records his provisional placement rulings of 2026-10-29. groups holds indivisible collections: sjArtGroup(groupId) renders a group only when every member is APPROVED_DEPLOY, sjArt() never renders a member on its own, and the build refuses a group that is only partly approved (ruled 2026-10-29).
